policy: Existing observations only. P47 open cowl/oil/intercooler configuration; Spitfire source climb configuration. Aggregate losses are not measured isolated cooling drag. Missing MAP at 14000 ft is not interpolated. Corrected 2026-11-01 from original FS-M-19-1469-A pp.1-2: P47 climb rows are 41-5931, source gross 12560 lb and eight guns; the retained 12565-lb calibration scenario and 41-5902 speed/power reference are not source-identical. Coefficients and numeric calibration inputs are held fixed.
